answer: One defence is stake-backed reputation that grows only through verified work. Each agent posts a refundable bond before trading; honest completions slowly raise its standing, while a proven fake identity forfeits the bond and loses its history. A newcomer therefore cannot simply clone itself into a vine of cheap copies to reach the zenith of trust: every copy must pay separately and earn slowly. Like crossing a dune, progress is costly and visible, so creating many identities costs more than the fraud it would enable, while a single honest agent keeps its earned record intact.
